title: Create a vertical photorealistic fashion
prompt: Create a vertical photorealistic fashion portrait of a cheerful young East Asian woman standing on a sunny coastal cliff above the ocean. She has long black hair blowing dramatically in the sea breeze, a bright open-mouthed smile, soft natural makeup, and both hands raised near her face in a playful claw-like pose. She wears a flowing white halter-style beach top with a deep neckline and a thin chain detail under the bust, paired with a pale blue-white sheer layered chiffon mini skirt that flares outward in the wind. Frame her from upper thighs to head in a full-body/three-quarter portrait, centered slightly left, with sunlit rocks and dry coastal grass in the foreground, turquoise-blue sea and foamy waves behind her, and a rugged limestone cliff on the right under a vivid blue sky with scattered white clouds. Use bright midday natural sunlight, airy summer mood, high-key color grading, realistic skin texture, crisp facial focus, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, and wind-swept fabric motion. Avoid text, logos, watermarks, extra people, distorted hands, or unnatural anatomy.
